eligibility.qualifier: Established diagnosis of type 2 diabetes mellitus
drug-naïve patients were required to have HbA1c >=7% and <=10%
patients treated with 1 oral anti-diabetes agent were required to have HbA1c >=7% and <=9.5%
HbA1c >=7% to <=10% at the start of the placebo run-in
Written informed consent obtained from all patients
Coronary revascularization, acute coronary syndrome, or stroke within 12 weeks
Active malignancy or life expectancy of less than 1 year

treatment with insulin, glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) analogues, sulfonylurea at > half the daily maximum approved dose or thiazolidinedione within 12 weeks prior to consent | Insulin, GLP-1 analogues, Sulfonylurea (> half max approved daily dose), Thiazolidinedione (within 12 weeks prior to consent)
treatment with anti-obesity drugs within 12 weeks prior to consent | Prohibited within 12 weeks prior to consent
use of any treatment at screening leading to unstable bodyweight | Prohibited (any treatment at screening leading to unstable bodyweight)
treatment with systemic steroids at time of consent | Prohibited at time of consent
change in dosage of thyroid hormones within 6 weeks prior to consent | Prohibited within 6 weeks prior to consent
alcohol or drug abuse within 12 weeks of consent | Prohibited within 12 weeks of consent
investigational drug intake within 30 days of consent | Prohibited within 30 days of consent
Participation in another clinical trial within 30 days
